description: C-130A-45-LM; Baugher's 1957 file states seen at Camp McCoy WI in use as a loading trainer with wings removed; Aerial Visuals duplicates this airframe at both Camp Douglas and Sparta and the Camp Douglas entry is the erroneous one; this is a training aid on an access-controlled post not a museum display
Aerial Visuals lists an AH-1 and a UH-1 at Fort McCoy without serials; recorded with a blank tail number rather than guessing
